name: VolumeOscillatorTool
description: Volume Oscillator - shows difference between two volume moving averages. Positive values indicate increasing volume trend, negative indicates decreasing volume.

fields.label: Candle Data
fields.description: The dataRef string returned from a market data tool (YahooFinanceTool, PolygonTool, etc). You MUST first call a market data tool, wait for its response containing dataRef, then use that exact dataRef value here. Do NOT guess or invent this value.

fields.label: Short Period
fields.description: Period for short-term volume moving average. Standard is 12 periods.

fields.label: Long Period
fields.description: Period for long-term volume moving average. Standard is 26 periods. Must be greater than short period.

fields.label: Calculation Type
fields.description: Output format: Percentage shows relative change, Absolute shows volume difference.
